newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat stock firms on weak Milan bourse.
newsitem.headline: Fiat stock firms on weak Milan bourse.

text.p: Shares in Italian industrial giant Fiat rose on a generally weak Milan bourse with the Agnelli family holding groups IFIL and IFI also posting strong advances.
Traders said there was market talk of extremely good new car registration data for February, not due to be published until around March 10.
Fiat has already said it expects new car orders to be considerably higher due to the recently introduced government incentive scheme to boost domestic demand.

At 1523 GMT, Fiat was up 2.85 percent at 5,235 lire after a session high at 5,345. IFIL posted a 4.14 percent gain to 5,160 and IFI preference shares were up 4.16 percent at 21,800 lire. The all-share Mibtel index was off 0.87 percent.
